data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2019 were USD 617.778m. Analysis of the gross claims development table shows a net prior-year adverse development of approximately USD 36.245m (about 5.9% of opening reserves), driven primarily by adverse development in the 2017 and 2016 underwriting years.
raw_causal_phrases: The principal assumption underlying the liability estimates is that the future claims development will follow a similar pattern to past claims development experience.
There is always a risk that the assumptions and techniques used in these models are unreliable or that claims arising from an unmodelled event are greater than those arising from a modelled event.

The uncertainty associated with the ultimate claims experience of an underwriting year is greatest when the underwriting year is at an early stage of development and when the risk margin for future experience potentially being more adverse than has been assumed is at its highest.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development amount was calculated from the gross claims development table (claims triangle) because no explicit 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' gross figure was located in the notes. Triangle has limited development rows for some years; as a result the PYD is an aggregate derived from columns with available diagonals (not all UW years had a full prior-diagonal). No verbatim narrative statement of the gross prior-year movement was found; exact_reserve_text left blank.
